about: Shared table for the permits(rightsUsed, surface) contract (PLAN 4.2, 6.1, M6; ADR 0006, ADR 0020). Run by pytest (tests/v2/test_rights.py) and Vitest (packages/core/src/rights.test.ts) so the two bodies cannot drift. A case with no register is asked of the committed rights register (schema/rights-register.json); those cases use an origin it does not list, or the legacy representation, so they hold whatever Alex signs. A case that names a register is asked of a gate built from that table under registers; those tables and their signatures are test data and decide nothing about any real source. reason_has, where given, is a phrase the denial must contain.

agency_direct.origin: An agency the register does not list

derived_two_inputs.origin: An agency the register does not list
